seo.title: Articles on Software, AI and Cloud
seo.description: Practical articles on software costs, choosing a development partner, AI automation and reliable hosting, with a focus on businesses in Morocco.

hero.title: Practical writing about building software.
hero.lead: Clear articles on costs, planning, automation and keeping software running, written by the people who do the work.

intro.title: Written for the people who decide.
intro.intro: Each article answers a question business owners ask us before a software project: what it costs, how to choose a partner, where automation helps and how to keep software running.
paragraphs: We write from the work itself, not from trends. Where a figure depends on your situation, we explain what drives it instead of quoting an average.
Articles are published in English, and some are also available in French and Arabic. Each one links to the services and products it relates to, so you can go from a question to a next step.
